# lua-slds · v0.2

> Short Link Domain Specification: a pure Lua library for Identity + Lifecycle + Resolution Semantics.

## Scope

- Lua 5.1 / Lua 5.3 / LuaJIT, zero runtime dependencies.
- Four operations through Interactor; two Core ports: Repository and optional CodeGenerator.
- Core never imports adapters or HTTP/database/cache/JSON/ngx libraries; it never fetches target URLs.
- Host owns transport, authorization, tenant policy, caching, scheduling and durable telemetry delivery.

## Current source API

- slds.new({repository,code_generator?,lifecycle?,clock?,hooks?}) -> Interactor.
- interactor:create(ctx,input) -> ShortLink | nil,err.
- interactor:resolve(ctx,identity) -> ResolutionResult | nil,err.
- interactor:update(ctx,identity,patch) -> ShortLink | nil,err.
- interactor:delete(ctx,identity) -> true | nil,err.
- hooks:on(point,fn) is the sole registration API; configure during startup. Interactor only dispatches. Same-point FIFO, fixed cross-point phases; no runtime registry mutation or priorities.
- Root exports VERSION/new/Interactor/Identity/ShortLink/Lifecycle/Resolution/Errors/Hooks/HookPoint; no Service/flat aliases.

## Contracts

- Identity is a non-empty namespace/code tuple, logically immutable ordinary Lua table; callers must not rewrite fields.
- Lifecycle has ACTIVE/DISABLED/DELETED and is_valid/can_transition/is_resolvable; partial functions default at construction. Hard identity/terminal guards cannot be relaxed.
- EXPIRED is derived at expires_at <= now, never stored. Resolution returns found and resolvable; use resolvable before target.
- Errors are exactly NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT/INVALID. Infrastructure errors pass unchanged. Dependency nil,nil or result+error is a programming error.
- Repository atomically validates sparse writes against its latest state; Interactor update/delete never get first. Deleted identities remain reserved.
- Patch permits only target/status/expires_at; unknown keys including metadata return INVALID, identity keys throw. Nil expiration means unchanged; no clearing sentinel.
- can_update(current,patch) belongs only in authoritative Repository, after complete validation; false returns INVALID. External CAS may return CONFLICT with separate evidence.
- Metadata is opaque independent raw-table graphs; no schema interpretation, update/deep merge or metatable transport.
- CodeGenerator returns final non-empty string; only omitted Code invokes it. No retries/coercion. Composed adapter runs inner Generator then ordered dense Encoder array.
- Sequential/Base62 integer domain [0,2^53-1] and instance-local exhaustion are adapter-specific; generic CodeGenerator is representation-agnostic.
- Hook order: general BEFORE, specific BEFORE, operation, specific AFTER, general AFTER. AFTER observes all normal failures too.
- Callbacks receive ctx,actual_point,payload..., AFTER includes value,err; ON_ERROR(ctx,failed_point,hook_err) does not recurse.
- Hook payloads are independent snapshots with root domain methods; ctx stays shared/read-only by convention. pcall isolates exceptions, not latency/durable delivery.

## Example

```lua
local slds = require("slds")
local interactor = slds.new({ repository = require("slds.adapters.inmemory.repository").new() })
local link = assert(interactor:create({}, { code = "hello", target = "https://example.com" }))
local result = assert(interactor:resolve({}, slds.Identity.new(link.namespace, link.code)))
if result.resolvable then print(result.target) end
```

## Evidence and files

- sh scripts/test.sh resets LuaCov and requires >=95% for every src/ and adapters/ production Lua file, including unloaded files.
- luacheck src/ adapters/ spec/ scripts/check-coverage.lua.
- Conformance uses real adapter fixtures. Sequential/interleaving evidence does not establish external concurrency, tenant isolation or cache invalidation.
- src/slds/interactor.lua: orchestration; src/slds/domain/: domain; src/slds/ports/: Repository/CodeGenerator.
- adapters/: InMemory, Composed, Sequential, Base62.
- docs/rfc/RFC-0002.md: current contracts; docs/rfc/RFC-0001.md: historical v0.1.
- docs/api.md: exact signatures; docs/migration-v0.2.md: breaking changes; docs/validation.md: measured results.
- openspec/ is currently Git-ignored; local proposals are not part of a commit by default.
